name: zeffect_animate_node_over_time
description: zEffect::AnimateNodeOverTime applies elapsed-time node animation setup, per-frame motion, DI blend scaling, and end-state snapping to camera/object3D targets.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this large node animation helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect event-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x45a9d0 validates null and negative-target guard return 2, runState-zero setup for scale/position-or-target/rotation-or-camera-position/DI alpha flags, frame-slice selection from eventElapsedSec and endTimeSec, object3D and camera dispatch, per-axis scale minimum clamp, DI blend clamp/flag handling, remaining frame-time subtraction, in-progress return 1, and end-state snap return 2.

The native zEffect smoke verifies guard behavior, object3D first-frame setup and elapsed movement, scale minimum clamp, DI alpha accumulation, end-state snapping for object position/rotation/scale/DI alpha, camera target/position dispatch, and frame-time consumption.
